title: FUNTASTIC Recalls Fake Teeth Due To Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: The gray surface paint on the teeth contains excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 26,000.

title: Michaels Stores Recalls Seasonal Writing Pens Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: The seasonal writing pens' surface coating contains high levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 310,000.

title: Fire Alarm Control Panel Recalled By Gamewell FCI Due to Alert Failure
summary: The sounder on the panel's main circuit board can fail to alert when there is a malfunction. Units: About 3,000.

title: OKK Trading Recalls Toy Robots Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: Surface paints on the toys contain excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 2,000.

title: American Honda Motor Co. Recalls ATVs Due to Loss of Steering Control
summary: The electric power steering shaft of the recalled ATVs could break unexpectedly, resulting in the rider's losing steering control. This poses a risk of injury or death to riders. Units: About 1,400.

title: Children's Board Book Sets Recalled By Dalmatian Press Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The cylinder on the toy concrete mixer and the tailgate on the toy dump truck can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 17,000.

title: Fingerhut Recalls Master Craft® Pressure Washers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The motor on the pressure washer can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 1,900.

title: Magnetic Dart Boards Recalled By Henry Gordy Int'l; Ingested Magnets Pose Aspiration and Intestinal Hazards
summary: Small magnets at the ends of the darts can detach. Magnets found by young children can be swallowed or aspirated. If more than one magnet is swallowed, the magnets can attract each other and cause intestinal perforations or blockages, which can be fatal. Units: About 870,000.

title: Plush Insect Toys Recalled by Dollar Tree Stores Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The recalled plush insect toys contain small parts, posing a choking hazard to small children. Units: About 300,000.

title: A.O. Smith Recalls Gas Water Heaters Due to Fire and Carbon Monoxide Hazards
summary: The water heater's flue gas temperatures can exceed safe limits and produce excessive temperatures in the venting unit, posing a fire hazard. Also, the water heater's exhaust can leak into the surrounding room, posing a carbon monoxide hazard. Units: About 1,500.

title: Children's 'Main Street Drag' Sunglasses Recalled by StyleMark Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: Surface paint in the orange lettering on the temples of the sunglasses contains excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 144,000.

title: Goodman Manufacturing Co. Recalls Heating and Cooling Units Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The serial plates on the units contain inaccurate information that could result in the use of undersized installation wiring, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 1,000.

title: Imaginarium Activity Centers Sold at Toys "R" Us Recalled Due to Choking Hazard
summary: Small parts on the toys can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 16,400.

title: Wal-Mart Recalls Candle Holders Due to Fire and Laceration Hazards
summary: The candle holders could tip over, posing a fire hazard. Also, the glass holder could break, posing a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 61,000.

title: Cabot Recalls Composite Deck Cleaner Due to Inhalation and Fire Hazard
summary: One of the components of the composite cleaner can react with metal foil residue on the packaging, releasing heat and chlorine gas. This poses a fire and inhalation hazard to consumers. Units: About 24,000.

title: Children's Hooded Sweatshirts Recalled by Brents-Riordan Inc. Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The garments have a drawstring through the hood, which can pose a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 7,400.

title: Gecko Alliance Recalls Electronic Spa Controls Used on Serenity Spas Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The hot tub's spa control can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 1,670.

title: Master Lock Recalls Lock and Leash™ Locks Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: Red surface paint on the locks contains excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 27,000.

title: CPSC, Kyodo America Recall LawnBott Lawn Mowers Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The cutting blades continue to rotate when the mower is lifted from the ground and the spacing on the side of the lawn mower could allow room for a consumer's foot to go beyond the shield and be struck by the blade. Both instances pose a serious laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 530.

title: Basketball and Flower Tables Recalled by Avon Products Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard; Sold in Puerto Rico and U.S. Virgin Islands
summary: Surface paint on the tables contains excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 1,000.

title: Fisher Controls International Recalls Gas Regulators for Leak Hazard
summary: Gas can leak from regulator when the diaphragm pulls inward into the casing, posing a fire or explosion hazard to consumers. Units: About 142,000.

title: Infant Santa Outfits Recalled by Avon Products Due to Choking Hazard; Sold in Puerto Rico and U.S. Virgin Islands
summary: The pom poms on the 2006 and 2007 outfit and the snaps on the 2007 outfit can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 17,000.

title: Waxcessories Recalls Electric Simmer Pots Due to Risk of Fire and Shock
summary: The simmer pots have wire connections that can become loose, posing a risk of fire and electric shock to consumers. Units: About 830,000.

title: Beco Baby Carrier Recalls "Beco Butterfly" Infant Carriers
summary: The buckles on the carrier shoulder straps can unexpectedly release tension, causing the strap to slip through, posing a fall hazard to the baby. Units: About 2,000.

title: Nashbar Direct Inc. Recalls Bicycle Resistance Trainers Due to Puncture Hazard
summary: The springs in the resistance trainers can unhook and become a projectile, posing a puncture hazard to users or bystanders. Units: About 200.

title: Performance Inc. Recalls Bicycle Resistance Trainers Due to Puncture Hazard
summary: The springs in the resistance trainers can unhook and become a projectile, posing a puncture hazard to users or bystanders. Units: About 3,000.

title: Wal-Mart Recalls Charm Key Chains Due to Risk of Lead Exposure
summary: The charms on the key chain can contain high levels of lead, which is toxic if ingested and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 12,000.

title: HSN Recalls Power Strips for Charge-It-All Valets Due to Fire and Shock Hazards
summary: The power strip located inside the valet has undersized wires, which can pose fire and shock hazards to consumers. Units: About 17,000.

title: Push Toys Recalled by Santa's Toy Corp. Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: Surface paint on the glove, shirt, and pants of rider toy contains excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 9,000.

title: Hobby-Lobby Int'l Recalls Battery Chargers Used with Helicopters Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The lithium-polymer batteries can ignite while charging, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 3,200.

title: DEWALT Recalls Table Saws Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The pivot bracket on the saw can separate, which can misalign the blade and the fence and cause kick back. This poses a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 13,000.

title: Hammocks Sold by LivingXL Recalled Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The metal frame for the hammocks can crack and break, causing a consumer to fall to the ground. Units: About 400.

title: Nintendo Recalls Lapel Pins Due to Risk of Lead Exposure
summary: The metal lapel pin contains high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 71,000.

title: Rio Brands Recalls High-Boy Beach Chairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The rear leg of the chair can break, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 800.
